description: PHASE-0 PROBE ONLY -- never ship this. Registers the recorder on the four events `docs/plan/research-step-mode.md` phase 0 asks about. PreToolUse carries a `.*` matcher deliberately: item 1 asks whether Agent/Task/Skill calls reach a hook at all, and a matcher naming them could not tell 'the event does not fire for those tools' from 'my matcher does not match them'. It is also the control -- ADR-0005 measured PreToolUse firing in live Cowork on 2026-07-30, so its lines are what separate a real negative from an uninstalled probe. SessionStart is registered even though ADR-0005 already found it does not fire in Cowork: it is the second control, and a re-measurement costs one line. UserPromptSubmit and Stop are the unmeasured ones.
